text:
asha: Heads-up — onboarding a new tenant (luna-ai) that needs p5 and g5 capacity in ap-southeast-3. Can someone start quota requests?

tom: Which instance families and rough numbers? also any ENI/vCPU needs for their infra?

asha: Asking for initial pool: p5.48xlarge x6, g5.48xlarge x8, and reserve for bursts to 12 each. They'll run multi-node sharded inference so need high ENI and vCPU headroom.

priya: OK. We'll need to raise regional accelerators and also ENI limits on the account/subnets. Do we have the AWS account ID and billing owner?

asha: Account: 123456789012 (luna-prod). Billing is via reseller account, but they gave us permission to request increases. I've got the support email thread saved.

tom: I can open the Support cases. Plan: one case for EC2 On-Demand quota (p5/p4/g5), one case for ENI limit, one for vCPU. I'll also ask for placement group capacity note.

priya: Sounds good. For ENI ask for at least 2000 ENIs in ap-southeast-3 and increase for ip-per-instance where applicable. Also request public IPv4 pool slack if they need external egress.

asha: FYI – they want predictable latency across AZs so prefer Dedicated capacity if possible later. For now just quota to launch.

infra-bot: Deploybot created support case: CASE-987654321 — "Request EC2 Accelerators (p5/g5) quota increase in ap-southeast-3". Link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#/case/?caseId=987654321

tom: Thanks infra-bot. I submitted additional cases: CASE-987654322 (ENI), CASE-987654323 (vCPU). Put the business justification in the case: multi-tenant inference cluster for Redwood customer, expected 24/7 usage, can provide contact if they ask for sales commitment.

priya: Can you paste the exact accelerate SKU names you requested? AWS sometimes asks for instance type + family.

tom: Sent these in the case: 
```
P5: p5.24xlarge, p5.48xlarge (accelerator family: p5)
P4d: p4d.24xlarge (if needed as fallback)
G5: g5.48xlarge, g5.12xlarge
Quantities: initial 6 p5.48xlarge, 8 g5.48xlarge; burst to 12 each
```

asha: Also note networking: they plan to use ENI Trunking and CNI from eks so might need increased IPs-per-node. Mention EFA not needed.

priya: Ok I'll attach their expected pod density and per-node IP chart to the ENI case.

tom: AWS asked for expected timeframe; I put 2-3 weeks to start launching, and flagged as "Production". They sometimes expedite with that.

asha: Cost question — Luna asked about committed capacity vs on-demand. Do we want to propose Dedicated or Savings Plan?

priya: For p5 it's usually custom reserved or committed dedicated. I'll loop in sales to draft a committed capacity offer after we confirm quotas.

tom: Noted. I'll update the internal onboarding doc and ping accounts once cases progress.

asha: Thanks — please post updates here. If AWS asks for contact, use infra-oncall@redwood.com. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: CASE-987654321 updated: "Requested capacity validated, awaiting AWS approval. ETA 3-5 business days."

tom: Great. I'll set a reminder to follow up in 4 days.

asha: Awesome, thanks team.
